        r_min = min(p[0] for p in b)
        c_min = min(p[1] for p in b)
        c_max = max(p[1] for p in b)

        r_min = min(p[0] for p in b)
        c_min = min(p[1] for p in b)
        c_max = max(p[1] for p in b)
        print(f"  {n['color']} row={r_min} col={c_min}-{c_max}")

# Check path segments
paths = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'w' and n['pixels'] == 4]
print(f"Path segments: {len(paths)}")
</parameter>
</function>
